title: Coordinator on homelessness.
bodyText: The governor shall appoint the coordinator on homelessness for the proper administration and enforcement of this chapter without regard to chapter 76.
bodyHtml: §346-381.5  Coordinator on homelessness.  The governor shall appoint the coordinator on homelessness for the proper administration and enforcement of this chapter without regard to chapter 76. [L 2019, c 81, §2; am L 2025, c 309, §9]
